title: Media Contacts
content: MEDIA CONTACTS Find a Source The Role of the Office of Strategic Communications The Office of Strategic Communications (OSC) is the primary contact between the Laboratory, the news media and the public. OSC prepares news releases, media advisories, statements on behalf of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), news and feature articles, fact sheets, brochures and other publications about the Laboratory’s work. OSC also: Responds to news media and community inquiries Arranges media visits and tours of the Laboratory Schedules talks and interactive demonstrations featuring LLNL researchers Whether you’re looking for an in-depth interview on a recent discovery or a quote about breaking news, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory’s media contacts can help journalists find the right source for their stories.
